description:
Spend totals from the audit log instead of reading every entry: for each
    group, total_cost (units) and calls. Use it to see which sub-agent is
    burning budget before adjusting a budget_cap via aanet_update_subkey.
    Owner_key required. An unknown group_by is an error.

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
api_key.title: Api Key

group_by.description: How to group the totals: "subkey_operation" (default), "subkey" or "operation".
group_by.title: Group By

since.description: ISO timestamp — only count entries at or after this time.
since.title: Since

workspace_id.description: The workspace_id from aanet_create_workspace or aanet_create_trial_workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: aanet_get_activity_summary
